annotations.title: Public record of a company (counterparty check)

description: Needs an Alion account or an x402 payment (not free on this open address). The public record of a company for a counterparty or vendor check: the status of its operating entity in the register, US federal court cases with an organisation on the other side (side, nature, filed, closed, docket link), regulators' fines, recalls and warning letters, insolvency notices (UK Gazette, BODACC), US political spending by cycle (employees and the company PAC, by party), greenhouse-gas emissions and toxic releases of its facilities, certifications (FedRAMP, CSA STAR, trust centres) and UK regulators' records. A company on a sanctions list is not served at all. Premium: $0.05 a call that answers with data. Docs: https://alion.io/developers/docs
